author: DOKKAN SPARKING
title: Hiring for Animation and Illustration Roles
content:
Hello! After getting everything sorted we are happy to inform you that we are currently trying to expand our team and hiring people for the development of new content for Project Sparking!   We are mainly looking for these next positions:

Asset animators and creators

Clean up + In-between animators
Colorists
Compositors

These are the main things we need at the moment, but if you are experienced in any other task like Layout, Illustration or any part of production feel free to reach out too!   If you are interested in the offer, throw us a private message with your work, the positions or tasks you would be interested in and your prices.  Thank you for your attention.
